Write a Python function that parses a MySQL slow query log entry and returns query_time and the query text
output:
import re

PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"^(?P<ts>\S+)\s+(?P<thread>\d+)\s+Query\s+(?P<query>.+)$", re.MULTILINE)
META = re.compile(
    r"# Query_time:\s+(?P<query_time>[\d.]+)\s+Lock_time:\s+(?P<lock_time>[\d.]+)\s+Rows_sent:\s+(?P<rows_sent>\d+)\s+Rows_examined:\s+(?P<rows_examined>\d+)")

def parse_slow_query(text):
    q = PATTERN.search(text)
    m = META.search(text)
    if not q:
        return {}
    out = {"query": q.group("query").strip()}
    if m:
        out["query_time"] = float(m.group("query_time"))
        out["lock_time"] = float(m.group("lock_time"))
        out["rows_sent"] = int(m.group("rows_sent"))
        out["rows_examined"] = int(m.group("rows_examined"))
    return out
